question: After the concrete defects are fixed, should OpenClaw land the default-enabled workspace plugin and agent-authored custom-widget execution together, or stage trusted workspaces before the custom-widget boundary?
rationale: VISION.md sets a high bar for optional bundled plugins and exceptional-size PRs, while this branch adds an unauthenticated route and approved agent-authored browser execution; implementation review cannot decide that permanent product and security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Stage trusted workspaces first
options.body: Land SQLite workspaces, the Control UI, and built-in widgets while moving custom-widget serving and execution to a focused follow-up.

options.title: Sponsor the integrated feature
options.body: Keep the full branch and accept its exceptional scope only after exact-head upgrade and adversarial security proof.

options.title: Move optional capability outward
options.body: Retain only any missing generic plugin seams in core and distribute the dashboard capability outside the bundled repository surface.

recommendation.title: Stage trusted workspaces first
recommendation.body: Land SQLite workspaces, the Control UI, and built-in widgets while moving custom-widget serving and execution to a focused follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the integrated hardening and is the strongest available current-main-connected owner for deciding whether the bundled product and security boundary should land.
